title: fix(gateway): requests go unanswered when a teammate is copied
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a new chat request receives no agent reply when a teammate is copied with an incidental mention such as `Please make poster previews. cc @Bob`.

## User Impact

Requests with copied teammates now run the agent and still notify those teammates. Messages beginning with a selected person remain human-only unless the agent is also named. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The human-addressing classifier treated every selected person as the addressee, even when the mention followed an agent request. Require the selected person to lead the message before suppressing the agent. Notification authorization, delivery, transcript persistence, and explicit agent-name overrides keep their existing owners.

This deliberately uses a simple positional rule rather than guessing intent from prose: greetings or other text before a person mention keep the agent turn.

## Evidence

- Reproduced through authenticated `chat.send` on an isolated real Gateway with a fixture model: the first copied-mention request terminated without starting the agent. Three focused incidental-mention cases also failed on the base.
- Final frozen snapshot: **8/8 focused tests passed**, including authenticated Gateway notification delivery, first-turn execution, direct-human no-interrupt behavior, and explicit agent-name override. Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/chat-human-mentions.test.ts src/gateway/server.mentions-committed.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`; wall time 77.31s including cold worker compilation; Gateway test time 31.48s, unit test time 31ms. CI timing pending.
- Core TypeScript, scoped type-aware lint, formatting, documentation links, test-line ratchet, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent local autoreview (Codex, GPT-6.1 Sol, P0–P2) covered the final local change against base `421fa7fcd556d4d8f0c92dcdcc046dedeb9e086c`: no actionable findings. Reviewer did not execute tests or inspect unchanged dispatch code; the Gateway proof covers that composition. Local ClawSweeper was unavailable because the discovered runner checkout was dirty/stale; hosted review follows the fallback route.
- No live deployment, provider behavior, or visual layout changes are claimed. One intermediate proof build refused a source edit during compilation; the final frozen rerun above passed.
- Simplification: no new state, API, config, or routing owner. Production delta: +7/-4 lines; test delta: +36 lines, extending the existing Gateway fixture rather than adding another boot. The scoped test-line allocation covers exactly that regression growth.
- **Inherited CI failure:** [check-docs, run 42792989086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42792989086/job/129751995961) fails formatting only in `test/scripts/full-release-receipt-recovery.test.ts`, `test/scripts/plugin-npm-cli-process.test.ts`, and `test/scripts/plugin-npm-cli-recovery.test-support.mjs`. All three are byte-identical to the tested main baseline `8c9a5cf064ff3d7b653c92daff84ab1ca74d5eea`; formatter inputs are unchanged. The same three failures reproduce locally, while all authored files pass CI-mode oxfmt/Bun parity. Documentation content checks pass. This is retained as failed CI, not relabeled green; landing uses the protected inherited-failure workflow.

Reported and requested by @vincentkoc.
